rules.failure_means: the partial products do not swing as the public Booth generator says, or something keeps them from reaching the tree on a zero operand
rules.what: the recoder is on A: a live zero costs more when it sits on B (partial products all-0 / all-1) than on A (every digit zero), though B moves twice as often

rules.failure_means: filling pairs saves nothing against one zero word in each pair: no eight-byte rule at this resolution
rules.what: int8's eight-byte B rule: the same eight zero words a line cost less when they fill (l, l+8) pairs

rules.failure_means: the RTL's pairing does not hold on silicon; if b_pairs_alt reads below b_pairs_rtl by more than the margin, A4's reading holds and every int8 gate figure on the page changes (kinds.json's gated_lane_frac_alt_grouping replaces gated_lane_frac)
rules.what: int8's column pairing: zero words filling (l, l+8) cost less than the same words filling (2l, 2l+1)

rules.failure_means: the (2l, 2l+1) arrangement differs from unpaired: a pairing the two readings do not describe, or a lane-position effect
rules.what: the control: (2l, 2l+1) pairs gate nothing, so they cost what unpaired zero words cost

rules.failure_means: a word with one nonzero byte is gated, or costs next to nothing live: the A test is not the whole word
rules.what: int8's A rule: three of four bytes zero leaves the lane on; four of four gates it

rules.failure_means: the zeros' sign does not matter: lanes on a -0 operand cost no more than gated ones in this mix
rules.what: the same sparse numbers cost more when half their zeros are -0.0, as x * mask leaves them
